info.title: Provider API for Freight Booking for Confirmation
info.description:
Provides functionality for managing the freight booking request confirmation process when integrating SAP Business Network for Logistics with external systems.
This specification describes the API from the perspective of SAP Business Network for Logistics as the provider of the API.
Other systems call the defined endpoints within SAP Business Network for Logistics.

x-sap-shortText: Enables carriers to manage the freight booking process.

x-servers.description: FreightBooking API endpoint for EU10 data center
FreightBooking API endpoint for US20 data center

externalDocs.description: Click here to access detailed implementation documentation.

eu10.description:
To use the EU10 data center API, you must obtain the OAuth client credentials (client ID and secret). 
To get the OAuth client credentials, create a customer incident on SAP support portal with the component as SBN-LBN-INT. 
Provide the SAP Business Network for Logistics ID created for your account and the email address to receive your client credentials. 
Specify the target integration platform as ‘Multi-Cloud (new)’ and the title as ‘SAP BN4L Integration Platform Migration: Request for new OAuth 2.0 credential’. 
Once you receive the credentials, pass the details to SAP HANA Cloud Platform token endpoint to obtain an access token.

post.summary: Creates a carrier response for a freight booking
post.description:
Creates a carrier response for a freight booking in SAP Business Network for Logistics.
With this functionality, a carrier can confirm or reject a freight booking.
When confirming, an alternative price can be proposed, if permitted by the ordering party.
The alternative price is the amount for which the carrier agrees to execute the transportation.
When rejecting, a reason code can be provided.

roleCode.description:
Represents the role of a party in a specific transportation order.
* 10    | Bill to Party
* TM009 | Communication Party 
* TM010 | Executing Carrier 
* TM013 | Issuing Carrier's Agent
* 1002  | Sales Representative Party
          Sales Representative 
              A sales representative is a party that carries out sales activities on behalf of a company
* 1003  | Voucher Copy Recipient Party
          Voucher Copy Recipient
              A VoucherCopyRecipientParty is a party that receives a voucher copy for the advertisement
* 1004  | Box Number Recipient
              Party
                  Box Number Recipient A BoxNumberRecipientParty is a party that receives the replies to a box number advertisement
* 1015  | Balance Responsible Party
              A Balance Responsible is a Utilities Market Participant Party (a wholesale company) in the utilities
              industry responsible (providing financial security) for the balance between the consumed and
              provided energy within a balance area.
* 1016  | Grid And Distribution Service Provider Party
              A Grid And Distribution Service Provider is a Utilities Market Participant Party that can provide grid
              access and distribution related services usually provided by distribution companies.
* 1017  | Balance Supplier Party 
              A Balance Supplier is a Utilities Market Participant Party that supplies balance (variable) power or
              gas to the energy consumer, having a supply contract with the energy consumer.
* 1018  | Meter Reader Party 
              Meter Reader 
                  A party who reads and records meter readings from meters (such as electricians, mechanics,technicians).
* 1020  | Contract Releaser Party 
              Contract Releaser 
                  A party who is authorized to release contracts (a synonym for "Contract Release Authorised Party").
* 1021  | Clean-Up Company Party
              Specifies the organization responsible for the clean-up of a material that was released during an incident.
* 1022  | Contact Person Party 
              Specifies the person who can be contacted.
* 1023  | Corporate Manager Party
              Specifies the person who is the corporate manager.
* 1024  | Disposal Company Party
              Specifies the organization responsible for the disposal of a material that was recovered, for example, after a release.
* 1025  | Emergency Responder Party
              Specifies the emergency services provider, for example, the police or an ambulance.
* 1026  | Environmental Compliance Manager Party
              Specifies the person responsible for managing an organization's environmental compliance responsibilities.
* 1027  | Equipment Operator Party
              Specifies the person who operates a piece of equipment.
* 1028  | Financial Transaction Remittee / Payer Party
              Specifies the person who pays for a financial transaction.
* 1033  | NOV Issuer Party
              Specifies the organization that issued the notice of violation (NOV).
* 1034  | Observed Person Party 
              Specifies the person who was observed as part of a safety observation.
* 1039  | Reporting Person Party
              Specifies the person who initially reported the incident.
* 1040  | Supervisor Party
              Specifies the person who is responsible for supervising employees.
* 1041  | Vehicle Driver Party
              Specifies the person who was driving the vehicle at the time of the incident.
* 1042  | Vehicle Insurer Party
              Specifies the person or organization that insures a vehicle.
* 1043  | Vehicle Owner Party
              Specifies the person or organization that owns a vehicle.
* 1044  | Vehicle Passenger Party
              Specifies the person who was riding in the vehicle at the time of the incident.
* 1101  | Invoicing Unit Party
              Invoicing Unit Synonym for Bill From Party
* 1122  | Contract Administrator
              A party that handles contract processing.

transportMeansID.description: An identifier for a means of transport. For example, a TransportMeansID can be the license plate of a truck or an identifier for a vessel.

transportMeansStandardId.description:
A standardized identifier for a means of transport, whereby the identification scheme used is controlled by an agency from the code list DE 3055.
For example, a TransportMeansStandardID can be the IMO identification number of a ship.

transportMeansHomeCountryCode.description: Represents the home country of a means of transport.

journeyID.description:
A journey is a sequence of locations that a carrier visits with a certain means of transport at a certain point in time.
A JourneyID is used, for example, in air transport to identify a flight between two airports at a given time from a given terminal. A synonym in air transport is flight number. In ocean transport this is also called voyage number.

transportationUnitResourceCategoryCode.description:
Represents a category of a transportation unit resource that is referenced by the booking capacity of a freight booking.

          Ground equipment being fuelled or serviced.
* AB  Chain 
          Chain used in the securing of cargo.
* AD  Temperature recorder 
          Temperature recorder to provide a record of the actual temperature.
* AE  Body trailer 
          The part of the vehicle where the cargo is loaded.
* AG  Slipsheet 
          A cardboard platform used for holding product for storage or transportation.
* AH  No special equipment needed 
          A code to indicate that there is no special equipment needed.
* AI  Vessel hold 
          A compartment forming part of a transport vessel.
* AJ  Flat rack 
          Type of open container used for carrying objects.
* AK  Aircraft 
          To indicate that the equipment is an aircraft.
* AL  Medical device 
          A device used for medical purposes.
* AM  Refrigerated container 
          A refrigerated (reefer) container that is actively cooling the product.
* AN  Synthetic pallet 80*120cm 
          A pallet with standard dimensions 80*120 centimetres made of synthetic material.
* AO  Synthetic pallet 100*120cm 
          A standard pallet with standard dimensions 100*120 centimetres made of synthetic material.
* AP  Clothing hanger rack 
          Equipment used to store and transport clothing in a hanging position.
* AQ  Road/rail trailer 
          Trailer designated for combined road/rail use.
* AT  Overhang wagon 
          Empty rail wagon added to the loaded wagons, when goods are longer than the loaded wagon.
* BL  Blocks 
          A piece of equipment that is normally a piece of wood to fix cargo (e.g. coils) during transport.
* BPN Box pallet non-exchangeable 
          A box pallet which cannot be exchanged.
* BPO Truck being transported 
          A road vehicle capable of carrying goods which is being carried on another means of transport.
* BPP Truck and trailer combination being transported
          A road vehicle capable of carrying goods with an attached trailer which is being carried on another means
          of transport.
* BPQ Tractor and trailer being transported
          A trailer accompanied by a self-propelling tractor unit which is being carried on another means of
          transport.
* BPR Postal bag 
          Bag intended primarily for the conveyance of postal items.
* BPS Letter Tray 
          Tray intended primarily for the conveyance of letter mail items of size slightly exceeding C5, in which the
          items are stood on their long edge.
* BPT Roller Cage 
          Wheeled wire cage.
* BPU Flats Tray 
          Tray intended primarily for the conveyance of letter mail items of from C5 up to in excess of C4, in which
          the items are stacked one on top of another. May also be used for letter mail smaller items stood on their
          long edge.
* BPV Out of bag parcel 
          Postal item, which is conveyed individually, with only the wrapping provided by the mailer for protection.

          transported goods. (Synonym: Lighter).
* BX  Boxcar 
          An enclosed railway goods wagon.
* CH  Chassis 
          A wheeled carriage onto which an ocean container is mounted for inland conveyance.
* CN  Container 
          Equipment item as defined by ISO for transport. It must be of 
          A) permanent character, strong enough for repeated use; 
          B) designed to facilitate the carriage of goods, by one or more modes of transport, without intermediate reloading; 
          C) fitted with devices for its ready handling, particularly.
* DPA Deadlight (panel) 
          A set of panels fixed inside a porthole.
* DPB Roll Pallet 2 
          120 X 60 cm pallet on casters.
* EFP Exchangeable EUR flat pallet 
          A flat euro-pallet that may be exchanged.
* EYP Exchangeable EUR Y box pallet

* FPN Flat pallet EUR non-exchangeable
          A flat euro-pallet that may not be exchanged.
* FPR Flat pallet (railway property) non-exchangeable
          A non-exchangeable flat pallet owned by a railroad.
* IL  Lidded stackable rigid tray (CEN TS 14482:2002)
          Lidded stackable rigid tray compliant with CEN TS 14482:2002.
* LAR Lashing rope 
          A rope for lashing cargo.
* LU  Load/unload device on equipment
          A mechanical device used in the loading and/or unloading of cargo into and from transport equipment.
* MPA Movable panel 
          A panel which can be moved.
* PA  Pallet 
          A platform on which goods can be stacked in order to facilitate the movement by a forklift or sling.
* PBP Identified private box pallet
          A box pallet identified as being privately owned.
* PFP Identified private flat pallet 
          A flat pallet identified as being privately owned.
* PL  Platform 
          A piece of equipment normally having a flat surface or prepared for carrying cargo with a specific shape.
* PPA Protecting panel 
          A panel used for protection.
* PST Portable stove 
          A portable heating unit.
* RF  Flat car 
          A railway wagon without raised sides or ends.
* RG  Reefer generator 
          A generator used to control the temperature in temperature-controlled transport equipment.
* RGF Ground facility 
          Storage tank or facility capable of receiving shipment of goods or commodity.
* RO  Rope 
          Rope used in the securing of cargo.
* RR  Rail car 
          To identify that the equipment is a rail car.
* SPP Identified special pallet 
          A pallet identified as special.
* STR Strap 
          A narrow strip of flexible material.
* SW  Swap body 
          Rectangular equipment unit without wheels, which can be mounted on a chassis or positioned on legs.
* TE  Trailer 
          A vehicle without motive power, designed for the carriage of cargo and to be towed by a motor vehicle.
* TP  Tarpaulin 
          Waterproof material, e.g. canvas, to spread over cargo to protect it from getting wet.
* TS  Tackles 
          Identification of loading tackle used (sheets, ropes, chains, etc.), as specified in DCU 9 to CIM Article 13;

* TSU Tarpaulin support

* UL  ULD (Unit load device)

transportationDocumentTypeCode.description:
Represents the type of a transportation-related document.
  Represents the type of a transportation-related document.
  * 1   Transportation Request 
          A transportation document of the type transportation request.
          A transportation request is a request to transport goods from one or more shippers to one or more
          consignees in accordance with agreed terms and conditions. In an intracompany integration scenario, the
          request can represent either an order-based transportation requirement (preliminary) or a delivery-based
          transportation requirement (final). In a B2B scenario, it can represent a forwarding quotation or a
          forwarding order. A transportation request can also include the assignment of transportation stages.
  * 2   Transportation Order 
          A transportation document of the type transportation order.
          A transportation order is an order from an ordering party to a carrier to transport goods from one or more
          shippers to one or more consignees in accordance with agreed terms and conditions. The order can also
          include the assignment of vehicle resources and transportation stages.
          The order can also have the character of a freight request for quotation that is sent to a carrier.

categoryCode.description:
Represents a category of a transportation unit resource.
* AA  Ground equipment 
              Ground equipment being fuelled or serviced.
* AB  Chain 
              Chain used in the securing of cargo.
* AD  Temperature recorder 
              Temperature recorder to provide a record of the actual temperature.
* AE  Body trailer 
              The part of the vehicle where the cargo is loaded.
* AG  Slipsheet 
              A cardboard platform used for holding product for storage or transportation.
* AH  No special equipment needed 
              A code to indicate that there is no special equipment needed.
* AI  Vessel hold 
              A compartment forming part of a transport vessel.
* AJ  Flat rack 
              Type of open container used for carrying objects.
* AK  Aircraft 
              To indicate that the equipment is an aircraft.
* AL  Medical device 
              A device used for medical purposes.
* AM  Refrigerated container 
              A refrigerated (reefer) container that is actively cooling the product.
* AN  Synthetic pallet 80*120cm 
              A pallet with standard dimensions 80*120 centimetres made of synthetic material.
* AO  Synthetic pallet 100*120cm 
              A standard pallet with standard dimensions 100*120 centimetres made of synthetic material.
* AP  Clothing hanger rack 
              Equipment used to store and transport clothing in a hanging position.
* AQ  Road/rail trailer 
              Trailer designated for combined road/rail use.
* AT  Overhang wagon 
              Empty rail wagon added to the loaded wagons, when goods are longer than the loaded wagon.
* BL  Blocks 
              A piece of equipment that is normally a piece of wood to fix cargo (e.g. coils) during transport.
* BPN Box pallet non-exchangeable 
              A box pallet which cannot be exchanged.
* BPO Truck being transported 
              A road vehicle capable of carrying goods which is being carried on another means of transport.
* BPP Truck and trailer combination being transported
              A road vehicle capable of carrying goods with an attached trailer which is being carried on another means
              of transport.
* BPQ Tractor and trailer being transported
              A trailer accompanied by a self-propelling tractor unit which is being carried on another means of
              transport.
* BPR Postal bag 
              Bag intended primarily for the conveyance of postal items.
* BPS Letter Tray 
              Tray intended primarily for the conveyance of letter mail items of size slightly exceeding C5, in which the
              items are stood on their long edge.
* BPT Roller Cage 
              Wheeled wire cage.
* BPU Flats Tray 
              Tray intended primarily for the conveyance of letter mail items of from C5 up to C4, in which
              the items are stacked one on top of another. May also be used for letter mail smaller items stood on their
              long edge.
* BPV Out of bag parcel 
              Postal item, which is conveyed individually, with only the wrapping provided by the mailer for protection.
* BPW Wheeled Platform 
              Device, consisting of a flat surface mounted on a wheels, which is designed for the conveyance of items
              which may safely be stacked. Normally also equipped with a handle to allow the device to be easily
              manoeuvred.
* BPX Container non-compliant with the Customs Convention on Containers
              The container is not compliant with the Customs Convention on Containers.
* BPY Box pallet EUR Y non-exchangeable
              A euro-pallet of type Y that may not be exchanged.
* BPZ Roll Pallet 1
              80 X 60 cm pallet on casters.
* BR  Barge 
              Flat bottomed inland cargo vessel for canals and rivers with or without own propulsion for the purpose of
              transported goods. (Synonym: Lighter).
* BX  Boxcar 
              An enclosed railway goods wagon.
* CH  Chassis 
              A wheeled carriage onto which an ocean container is mounted for inland conveyance.
* CN  Container 
              Equipment item as defined by ISO for transport. It must be of 
              A) permanent character, strong enough for repeated use; 
              B) designed to facilitate the carriage of goods, by one or more modes of transport, without intermediate reloading; 
              C) fitted with devices for its ready handling, particularly.
* DPA Deadlight (panel) 
              A set of panels fixed inside a porthole.
* DPB Roll Pallet 2 
              120 X 60 cm pallet on casters.
* EFP Exchangeable EUR flat pallet 
              A flat euro-pallet that may be exchanged.
* EYP Exchangeable EUR Y box pallet 
              A euro-pallet of type Y that may be exchanged.
* FPN Flat pallet EUR non-exchangeable
              A flat Euro pallet that may not be exchanged.
* FPR Flat pallet (railway property) non-exchangeable
              A non-exchangeable flat pallet owned by a railroad.
* IL  Lidded stackable rigid tray (CEN TS 14482:2002)
              Lidded stackable rigid tray compliant with CEN TS 14482:2002.
* LAR Lashing rope 
              A rope for lashing cargo.
* LU  Load/unload device on equipment
              A mechanical device used in the loading and/or unloading of cargo into and from transport equipment.
* MPA Movable panel 
              A panel which can be moved.
* PA  Pallet 
              A platform on which goods can be stacked to facilitate the movement by a forklift or sling.
* PBP Identified private box pallet
              A box pallet identified as being privately owned.
* PFP Identified private flat pallet 
              A flat pallet identified as being privately owned.
* PL  Platform 
              A piece of equipment normally having a flat surface or prepared for carrying cargo with a specific shape.
* PPA Protecting panel 
              A panel used for protection.
* PST Portable stove 
              A portable heating unit.
* RF  Flat car 
              A railway wagon without raised sides or ends.
* RG  Reefer generator 
              A generator used to control the temperature in temperature-controlled transport equipment.
* RGF Ground facility 
              Storage tank or facility capable of receiving shipment of goods or commodity.
* RO  Rope 
              Rope used in the securing of cargo.
* RR  Rail car 
              To identify that the equipment is a rail car.
* SPP Identified special pallet 
              A pallet identified as special.
* STR Strap 
              A narrow strip of flexible material.
* SW  Swap body 
              Rectangular equipment unit without wheels, which can be mounted on a chassis or positioned on legs.
* TE  Trailer 
              A vehicle without motive power, designed for the carriage of cargo and to be towed by a motor vehicle.
* TP  Tarpaulin 
              Waterproof material, e.g. canvas, to spread over cargo to protect it from getting wet.
* TS  Tackles 
              Identification of loading tackle used (sheets, ropes, chains, etc.), as specified in DCU 9 to CIM Article 13;
              and of containers, as specified in Articles 5 and 10 of Annex III to CIM (CIM 17).
* TSU Tarpaulin support 
              A device to support a tarpaulin.
* UL  ULD (Unit load device) 
              An aircraft container or pallet.
